owner_question: Do we make the short more like this where it starts with me close up on the phone talking to the audience

reference.title: Antarctica Is Bigger Than You Think
reference.same_creator_as: the owner's original EP009 direction, 'avatar forward like cleo abrams' and 'we have to make them like Cleo Abram'

how_it_was_read.method: nine frames sampled by canvas capture at 0.4, 1.6, 3.5, 7, 12, 18, 25, 31 and 36.5 seconds
how_it_was_read.limitation: Frames only. No audio was captured and the piece was not watched end to end, so pacing within a shot and the sound design are not assessed.

observed_structure.picture: tight presenter close-up, handheld phone feel, head and shoulders with hands up in frame, animated gesture, interior with framed pictures behind
full-screen globe and map graphics, Antarctica outlined, the United States overlaid in red for scale
map with labels and markers, plus a burned-in yellow SUBSCRIBE button
photographic ice footage with Burj Khalifa and Eiffel Tower scale overlays, then a figure walking an ice sheet with an arrow annotation
globe showing the world underwater, then a labelled diagram. The presenter does not return.

measured_against_our_rules.presenter_share: about 3 of 37.6 seconds, roughly 8 percent. Ours run 0.30 to 0.50.
measured_against_our_rules.presenter_return: absent. It ends on a graphic. The owner-locked EP007 grammar requires the presenter to return and land the conclusion, and the owner re-ruled that this session.
measured_against_our_rules.captions: burned in on every sampled frame. Boundary Ledger U-06 names full narration duplicated as kinetic type as a failure, and the clean-frame lock removed persistent chrome.
measured_against_our_rules.subscribe_button: burned into the picture. Nothing in our rules permits drawing a platform affordance into the frame.
measured_against_our_rules.framing: tight, handheld, phone. The EP009 look lock is a seated medium shot at a wooden table in an inn breakfast room.

repo_rule_that_governs_this: The EP007 standalone-shorts lock states that creator references supply high-level grammar, not surface imitation (precedent-index.md, standalone companion Shorts entry).

recommendation.adopt: The opening close-up. Open tight on the presenter rather than on a seated medium shot, so the face carries the first two seconds at phone size. This is a framing change inside presenter_address, it costs nothing extra because the takes are not generated yet, and it conflicts with nothing that is locked.
do_not_adopt: dropping the presenter return, which the owner locked and re-ruled
burned-in captions throughout, against U-06 and the clean-frame lock
replacing the locked seated inn look with a handheld phone setting
recommendation.open_question_for_the_owner: Presenter share. The reference sits near 8 percent and our four sit between 30 and 50. Opening tighter does not change that ratio. Cutting it would mean moving words from the presenter movements into the screens movement, which changes the beat assignment that is still unruled.

status: Agent reading of a creator reference. Not a rule change, and nothing here is owner acceptance.
